literal: On wuzi day, willow-target archery was held at the Taizu traveling palace.
idiomatic: On wuzi day he shot at the willow at the Taizu traveling palace.

literal: On guisi day, the sese rite was performed.
idiomatic: On guisi day he performed the sese rite.

literal: In the sixth month, on bingwu day, Tlübu presented Wugu captives.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingwu day, Tlübu brought in prisoners from the Wugu campaign.

literal: On wushen day, rewards were distributed to officers and soldiers.
idiomatic: On wushen day he divided spoils among officers and rank and file.

literal: On jiyou day, he toured westward.
idiomatic: On jiyou day he set out on a western tour.

literal: On jiwei day, he selected several thousand light horsemen to hunt the near mountains.
idiomatic: On jiwei day he picked out several thousand light cavalry and hunted the foothills.

literal: On guihai day, the imperial train halted at Liangjing.
idiomatic: On guihai day the court encamped at Liangjing.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengchen day, he inspected the marketplace and granted a partial amnesty to prisoners in custody.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, on gengchen day, he walked the market and pardoned many of the jailed.

literal: On jiawu day, he sacrificed to Taizu and turned east.
idiomatic: On jiawu day he offered at Taizu's shrine and marched east.

literal: In the eighth month, on xinchou day, returning from Liangjing, he visited the Taizu temple.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinchou day, he came back from Liangjing and bowed at the Taizu temple.

literal: On guimao day, he visited the Prince of Ren's residence.
idiomatic: On guimao day he called at the Prince of Ren's house.

literal: On jiyou day, he visited the Taizu temple.
idiomatic: On jiyou day he again visited the Taizu temple.

literal: In the ninth month, on gengwu day, he went to the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu day, he traveled to the Southern Capital.

literal: On wuyin day, he sacrificed at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: On wuyin day he made sacrifice at Mount Muye.

literal: On jimao day, the rebirth rite was performed.
idiomatic: On jimao day he performed the rebirth rite.

literal: On guisi day, he reached the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: On guisi day he arrived at the Southern Capital.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on renyin day, he visited the Prince of Ren's residence and feasted the assembled ministers.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on renyin day, he visited the Prince of Ren and held a feast for his ministers.

literal: On jiachen day, he visited the various camps and inspected the military registers.
idiomatic: On jiachen day he toured the encampments and reviewed the muster rolls.

literal: On gengxu day, because the Yunzhong commanderies and counties had not yet fallen, he held a great review of the Six Armies.
idiomatic: On gengxu day, with Yunzhong's prefectures and counties still holding out, he mustered the Six Armies in full parade.

literal: On jiazi day, an edict ordered Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu to lead troops toward Yunzhong to subdue the unaffiliated commanderies and counties.
idiomatic: On jiazi day he decreed that Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu take the field for Yunzhong and bring in every county and commandery still outside the fold.

literal: On the bingyin new moon of the eleventh month, the departure for campaign was announced to Heaven and Earth.
idiomatic: At the bingyin new moon of the eleventh month he reported the march to Heaven and Earth.

literal: On dingmao day, Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu was given a farewell feast at the western suburb.
idiomatic: On dingmao day he saw Li Hu off with a feast in the western suburb.

literal: On renshen day, the Grand Inner tixin was ordered to announce the campaign at the Taizu traveling palace.
idiomatic: On renshen day he sent the Grand Inner tixin to proclaim the campaign at the Taizu traveling palace.

literal: On jiashen day, he watched the fishing at Sanchakou.
idiomatic: On jiashen day he watched the seine haul at Sanchakou.

literal: In the twelfth month, on wushen day, the Jurchen came with tribute.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wushen day, the Jurchen brought tribute.

literal: On wuwu day, he returned from the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: On wuwu day he came back from the Southern Capital.

literal: The fifth year of Tianxian
idiomatic: The fifth year of Tianxian

literal: In the spring of the fifth year, on gengwu day in the first month, Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu captured Huan Prefecture; word of victory arrived.
idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year, on gengwu day in the first month, Li Hu took Huan Prefecture and sent word of triumph.

literal: On jiawu day, he attended audience with the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On jiawu day he attended the Empress Dowager at court.

literal: In the second month, on jihai day, an edict ordered repairs to the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai day, he decreed the repair of the Southern Capital.

literal: On guimao day, Li Hu returned from Yunzhong and attended at the traveling court.
idiomatic: On guimao day Li Hu came back from Yunzhong and appeared at the traveling court.

literal: On bingwu day, the Bohai households captured earlier were granted to Li Hu.
idiomatic: On bingwu day he gave Li Hu the Bohai households taken in the earlier campaign.

literal: On bingchen day, the Emperor and the Prince of Ren attended the Empress Dowager together.
idiomatic: On bingchen day he and the Prince of Ren went together to the Empress Dowager.

literal: Because all were skilled at calligraphy, the Empress Dowager ordered them to write before her so she might watch.
idiomatic: Finding them all accomplished with the brush, the Empress Dowager had them write before her for her pleasure.

literal: On xinyou day, he summoned the ministers to discuss state and military affairs.
idiomatic: On xinyou day he called in his ministers to debate affairs of state and war.

literal: In the third month, on bingyin day, he attended audience with the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin day, he attended the Empress Dowager at court.

literal: On dingmao day, Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu requested amnesty for imprisoned members of the imperial clan and the shili langjun; an edict granted it.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Li Hu asked pardon for kinsmen of the house and shili langjun held in prison, and the Emperor assented.

literal: On jisi day, he visited Imperial Uncle Anduan's residence.
idiomatic: On jisi day he called at Imperial Uncle Anduan's house.

literal: On xinwei day, the Prince of Ren presented white ramie cloth.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the Prince of Ren offered white ramie cloth.

literal: On yihai day, Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu was enfeoffed as Shouchang Imperial Younger Brother; collation: the manuscript erroneously reads zi (son) for di (younger brother).
idiomatic: On yihai day he enfeoffed Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu as Shouchang Imperial Younger Brother; in collation, the text wrongly has zi where di belongs.

literal: Corrected according to the first month of the eighth year below, his separate biography in scroll 72, and the table of imperial sons.
idiomatic: The reading follows the first month of the eighth year below, his biography in scroll 72, and the table of imperial sons.

literal: He was also made Great Marshal over all military forces.
idiomatic: He was also named Great Marshal over all military forces.

literal: On renwu day, Liu Juyan, military commissioner of Longhua Circuit, was made Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
idiomatic: On renwu day Liu Juyan, commissioner of Longhua Circuit, was made Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

literal: On yiyou day, he feasted the Prince of Ren's staff in the side hall.
idiomatic: On yiyou day he held a banquet in the side hall for the Prince of Ren's officers.

literal: On gengyin day, the imperial train departed the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the court left the Southern Capital.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yiwei day, an edict ordered the Prince of Ren to go first to the ancestral tombs and visit the Taizu temple.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on yiwei day, he decreed that the Prince of Ren precede him to the ancestral tombs and bow at the Taizu temple.

literal: On bingchen day, they met at the ancestral tombs.
idiomatic: On bingchen day they gathered at the ancestral tombs.

literal: The Prince of Ren returned to his state.
idiomatic: The Prince of Ren went home to his realm.

literal: In the fifth month, on wuchen day, an edict ordered repairs to the Liaotan detached palace.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuchen day, he decreed the repair of the Liaotan detached palace.

literal: On yiyou day, he visited the Taizu temple.
idiomatic: On yiyou day he visited the Taizu temple.

literal: In the sixth month, on jihai day, willow-target archery was held at the traveling court.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jihai day, he shot at the willow at the traveling court.

literal: On yimao day, he went to Lake Yanliu.
idiomatic: On yimao day he went out to Lake Yanliu.

literal: On dingsi day, he bowed before Taizu's portrait in Bright Hall.
idiomatic: On dingsi day he bowed before Taizu's portrait in Bright Hall.

literal: On jiwei day, Dilie came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Dilie brought tribute.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renshen day, the Wugu came with tribute.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, on renshen day, the Wugu sent tribute.

literal: On wuzi day, seasonal fruit was offered at the Taizu temple.
idiomatic: On wuzi day he offered the season's fruit at the Taizu temple.

literal: In the eighth month, on dingyou day, the Great Sage Emperor's and the Empress's sleeping quarters were named Sun-and-Moon Palace, and a Sun-and-Moon stele was erected.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou day, he named the Great Sage Emperor's and the Empress's bedchambers Sun-and-Moon Palace and raised a Sun-and-Moon stele.

literal: On bingwu day, he went to the Nine-Tier Terrace.
idiomatic: On bingwu day he went to the Nine-Tier Terrace.

literal: In the ninth month, on jimao day, an edict ordered Shili Puning to comfort and reassure the Prince of Ren.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jimao day, he decreed that Shili Puning go to soothe the Prince of Ren.

literal: On gengchen day, an edict established a guard of honor for the Prince of Ren.
idiomatic: On gengchen day he decreed a guard of honor for the Prince of Ren.

literal: On dinghai day, returning from the Nine-Tier Terrace, he visited the Taizu temple.
idiomatic: On dinghai day, coming back from the Nine-Tier Terrace, he visited the Taizu temple.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuxu day, envoys were dispatched to grant sacrificial meat to the Prince of Ren.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on wuxu day, he sent envoys with sacrificial meat for the Prince of Ren.

literal: On guimao day, Taizu's stele of sacred achievement was erected at the Ruyu Zhengji assembly mound.
idiomatic: On guimao day he raised Taizu's stele of sacred achievement at the Ruyu Zhengji assembly mound.

literal: On jiachen day, the Prince of Ren presented a jade flute.
idiomatic: On jiachen day the Prince of Ren offered a jade flute.

literal: In the eleventh month, on wuyin day, Eastern Dandel reported that the Prince of Ren had put to sea and fled to Tang.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuyin day, Eastern Dandel reported that the Prince of Ren had taken to the sea and fled toward Tang.

literal: The sixth year of Tianxian
idiomatic: The sixth year of Tianxian

literal: In the spring of the sixth year, on jiazi day in the first month, a southwestern frontier commander brought in Kirghiz people who had submitted to Khitan rule.
idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year, on jiazi day in the first month, a commander on the southwestern frontier brought in Kirghiz who had come under Khitan sway.

literal: On yichou day, Dilie came with tribute.
idiomatic: On yichou day Dilie brought tribute.

literal: On dingmao day, he went to the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: On dingmao day he traveled to the Southern Capital.

literal: In the third month, on xinwei day, he summoned the great ministers to discuss state and military affairs.
idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei day, he called in his chief ministers to debate affairs of state and war.

literal: On dinghai day, the Prince of Ren's consort, Lady Xiao, led the officials and staff of his state to audience.
idiomatic: On dinghai day the Prince of Ren's consort, Lady Xiao, came with the officers and staff of his realm to audience.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou day, Tang dispatched envoys on a diplomatic visit.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on jiyou day, Tang sent envoys on a courtesy mission.

literal: That month the Central Secretariat was established at the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: That month he set up the Central Secretariat at the Southern Capital.

literal: In the fifth month, on yichou day, he sacrificed at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yichou day, he sacrificed at Mount Muye.

literal: On yihai day, he returned from the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: On yihai day he came back from the Southern Capital.

literal: On renwu day, he visited Taizu's tomb.
idiomatic: On renwu day he visited Taizu's tomb.

literal: In the intercalary month, on gengyin day, willow-target archery was held in the near suburbs.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengyin day, he shot at the willow in the near suburbs.

literal: In the sixth month, on renshen day, he went to Liangjing.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renshen day, he went to Liangjing.

literal: On renwu day, the Wugu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On renwu day the Wugu brought tribute.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dinghai day, the Jurchen came with tribute.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, on dinghai day, the Jurchen sent tribute.

literal: On jiyou day, he ordered commanders and officers to lead troops south on a raid.
idiomatic: On jiyou day he ordered his commanders to take troops south on a raid.

literal: On renzi day, seasonal fruit was offered at the Taizu temple.
idiomatic: On renzi day he offered the season's fruit at the Taizu temple.

literal: He toured eastward.
idiomatic: He set out on an eastern tour.

literal: In the eighth month, on gengshen day, the imperial son Shulü was born; the Taizu temple was notified.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengshen day, the imperial son Shulü was born, and the birth was announced at the Taizu temple.

literal: On xinsi day, the Biegude came with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinsi day the Biegude brought tribute.

literal: In the ninth month, on jiawu day, an edict ordered repairs to the capital.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiawu day, he decreed the repair of the capital.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on dingchou day, the Tieli came with tribute.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on dingchou day, the Tieli sent tribute.

literal: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, Tang dispatched envoys on a diplomatic visit.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, Tang sent envoys on a courtesy mission.

literal: On the jiayin new moon of the twelfth month, the Taizu temple was sacrificed to.
idiomatic: At the jiayin new moon of the twelfth month he sacrificed at the Taizu temple.

literal: On bingchen day, envoys were dispatched to present an edict and gifts to Tang's Lulong Circuit military commissioner Zhao Dejun.
idiomatic: On bingchen day he sent envoys with an edict and gifts to Zhao Dejun, military commissioner of Tang's Lulong Circuit.

literal: The seventh year of Tianxian
idiomatic: The seventh year of Tianxian

literal: In the spring of the seventh year, on renchen day in the first month, Western Campaign General Keli sent Zhaila Tuoguo to report on military affairs.
idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year, on renchen day in the first month, Western Campaign General Keli sent Zhaila Tuoguo with a military report.

literal: On jihai day, Tang dispatched envoys on a diplomatic visit.
idiomatic: On jihai day Tang sent envoys on a courtesy mission.

literal: On guimao day, envoys were dispatched to Tang.
idiomatic: On guimao day he sent envoys to Tang.

literal: On wushen day, he sacrificed at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: On wushen day he sacrificed at Mount Muye.

literal: In the second month, on renshen day, Zhaila Dide returned from a mission to Wuyue; the King of Wuyue sent envoys with him and presented precious vessels.
idiomatic: In the second month, on renshen day, Zhaila Dide came back from Wuyue; the King of Wuyue sent envoys in his train and offered precious vessels.

literal: Envoys were again dispatched bearing gifts to return the courtesy.
idiomatic: He again sent envoys with gifts to answer the courtesy.

literal: In the third month, on jichou day, Linya Dilübi pointed at and reviled the imperial carriage and was imprisoned.
idiomatic: In the third month, on jichou day, Linya Dilübi cursed the imperial carriage to its face and was taken into custody.

literal: On dingwei day, envoys were dispatched to the various states.
idiomatic: On dingwei day he sent envoys to the various states.

literal: On wushen day, the Emperor led the assembled ministers in audience with the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On wushen day he led his ministers to attend the Empress Dowager at court.
